identity.title: Pokémon Ranger the Comic: Double Mission

source.sourceCategory: Category:Pokémon Ranger the Comic: Double Mission

leadText:
Pokémon Ranger the Comic: Double Mission (Japanese: ミッションストーリー ポケモンレンジャー the Comic Mission Story: Pokémon Ranger - the Comic) is a based on the W Mission of . It is written by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto. It is set in the same continuity as Pokémon Adventures, as evidenced in The Final Dimensional Duel XI . A manga featuring the game's sequel, Shadows of Almia, was also released under the name Pokémon Ranger: The Comic – Shadows of Almia.

The manga was available online to members of the Pokémon Daisuki Club. The first chapter is available in the book The Art of Pokémon Adventures.
